column1: # Data files the app reads through code, and the sources that read them.
# mutate_diff.py judges a change to a data file by the tests naming the file and
# the tests reaching each source listed here (its stem, header and class), so a
# test that reads the file through a loader runs too.
# glob<TAB>source<TAB>evidence[<TAB>names]: `*` crosses `/`; evidence is text the
# source must contain (the file name it opens, or the loader it calls). Names,
# comma-separated, replace the source's stem, header and class when the loader is
# one function of a file too many tests name: each is the loader's name in the
# source, or a path fragment of the data file that tests open directly.
# tests/python/test_mutate_diff.py fails when a source no longer contains them.
